sonnet.problem: Card 7 already asked about Luke 17:31 (the person on the housetop should not come down for his possessions). Card 8 asks the same point again about the person in the field. The two lines of verse 31 make one point, and card 7's answer gives away card 8's.
sonnet.rule: An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact. Two lines that make the same point get one question. An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.
